note: Maps requirements (§2.2) and acceptance tests (§18) to test tags and the phase that must cover them. status 'covered' means every tag must appear in a passing test in reports/vitest-junit.xml; 'partial' is the same check plus a note on what remains; 'planned' has no tests yet.

entries.note: 95 cross-language vectors; scripts/check-contracts.mjs reruns the Python implementation.
Markdown projection is complete for Appendix A families. The no-JavaScript reading test is Phase 1.
Frontmatter docId schema, duplicate-ID rejection, and ID stability under moves (spans, model tests). Copy and deletion lifecycle are Phases 1 and 3.
Targets for all Appendix A kinds; browser reference selection for the graph relationship. Per-kind browser references for every §18.4 kind are Phase 2.
Edges and nodes open labelled details with evidence from the SVG and from the relationship list (browser journeys).
Definition tooltip on hover/focus and tap-to-open. Real touch-device review is a human gate.
Variables, functions, if/partial, raw HTML, and unknown tags are rejected before transform. Untrusted-extension fixtures are Phase 5.
Packets resolve by doc ID and target ID; renamed folders, forged hints, and the browser-copied packet resolve through the CLI.
Stale packets refuse guarded writes; refresh is required; concurrent-writer check before rename (T20).
Markdown projection is generated from the model with full target and relationship coverage. HTML and reference-map derivation are Phase 1.
Manifest-only server: GET/HEAD only, Host allowlist, no source or guessed paths, encoded traversal rejected.
Source revision, build ID, canonical JSON, and cross-language vectors.
ids assign preserves existing IDs and other bytes. Guarded-edit preservation (T15) is Phase 1.
Inserting a paragraph above a target keeps its ID and shifts only its span.
A moved edge resolves stale with targetBodyUnchanged=true, from a browser-copied packet.
Identical paragraphs get independent IDs and spans. Quote-based resolution is Phase 1.
Duplicate IDs fail with E_ID_DUPLICATE (fixtures/negative/E_ID_DUPLICATE). Resolver-level rejection is Phase 1.
The packet keeps the viewed revision; resolve surfaces staleness after the source changes.
Packet agreement checks and resolver-level invalid for a wrong body at the current revision.
Same source with a different toolkit gives a different build ID.
